n. (-णं)
A Purāṇa or sacred and poetical work, supposed to be compiled or composed by the poet VYĀSA; and comprising the whole body of Hindu theology: each Purāṇa should treat of five topics especially; the creation, the destruction, and renovation of worlds; the genealogy of gods and heroes; the reigns of the Menus, and the transactions of their descendants: but great variety prevails in this respect, and few contain historical or genealogical matter. There are eighteen acknowledged Purāṇas.
1 BRĀHMA.
2 Pādma, or the lotus.
3 Brahmāṇḍa, or the egg of BRAHMA.
4 Āgneya, or Agni fire.
5 VAIṢṆAVA, or of VIṢṆU.
6 Garuḍa.
7 Brahmavaivarta, or transformations of BRAHMA, that is of KṚṢṆA, identified with the Supreme.
8 ŚAIVA, or of ŚIVA.
9 Liṅga.
10 NĀRADĪYA.
11 SKANDA.
12 MĀRKAṆḌEYA, so called from a Muni of that name.
13 Bhaviṣyat, or prophetic.
14 Mātsya, or the fish.
15 Vārāha, or boar.
16 Kaurma, or of the Kūrma or tortoise.
17 Vāmana, or dwarf, and
18 The Bhāgavata, or life of KṚṢṆA, which last is by some considered as a spurious and modern work: the Brahmavaivarta is also of very modern origin. The Purāṇas are reckoned to contain four hundred thousand stanzas: there are also eighteen Upapurāṇas or similar poems of inferior sanctity, and different appellations; the whole constitute the popular or poetical creed of the Hindus, and some of them or particular parts of them, are very generally read, and studied.

A sort of bird, described as having a double or cleft beak; also नासाच्छिन्नी.
E.
पूर्ण full, कन् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Satisfied, satiated.
E.
पूर्ण fulfilled, काम desire.

m. (-म्भः)
1 A water vessel, one filled with holy water, used at the consecration of a king.
2 A full cup or jar.
E.
पूर्ण full, and कुम्भ a water jar.

n. (-चं)
1 A full cup or vessel.
2 A vessel filled with clothes or ornaments, which are scrambled for by the guests and relations at a festival.
3 A vessel full of rice, presented at a sacrifice to the superintending and officiating priests; the Pūrṇa Pātra is properly a measure of 256 handfuls of rice; it may also be composed of as much as will satisfy one great eater.
E.
पूर्ण full, and पाच a vessel.

f. (-मा)
The day of full moon.
E.
पूर्ण full, मा the moon; also पूर्णिमा, &c.

m. (-सः)
A monthly sacrifice, performed on the day of full moon; also पार्णमास.
f. (-सी)
Day of full moon.
E.
पूर्ण complete, मास the month.

m. (-जः)
The citron.
E.
पूर्ण, and वीज seed.

n. (-कं)
1 A vessel full of clothes, &c. at a feast: see पूर्णपात्र.
2 The sound of a drum.
3 A moon-beam.
E.
पूर्ण full, अन to go, or be, aff. वुन्; also read पूर्णालक.

n. (-कं)
A vessel of clothes or ornaments to be scrambled for.
E.
पूर्ण full, अल to ornament, aff. ण्वुल्; also sometimes written पूर्णानक.

f. (-मा)
Day of full moon.
E.
पूर्ण full, (the moon,) इमक् aff.

m. (-न्दुः)
The moon, the full moon.
E.
पूर्ण, and इन्दु the moon.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
1 Filled, full, complete.
2 Covered, concealed.
n. (-र्त्तं)
1 An act of pious liberality, as digging a well, planting a grove, building a temple, &c.
2 Nourishing, cherishing.
E.
पॄ to cherish or fill, aff. क्त, and the vowel changed.

f. (-र्त्तिः)
Fulness, completion.
E.
पॄ to satisfy or fill, aff. क्तिच्.

mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिणी-र्त्ति)
Filling, completing.
2 Effective.
E.
प to satisfy, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Prior, before, preceding.
E.
पूर्व्व, and कन् added.

n. (-लं)
Former time.
E.
पूर्व्व, and काल time.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Ancient, belonging to former times.
E.
पूर्व्वकाल, and ख aff.

f. (-ष्ठा)
The east, the eastern quarter.
E.
पूर्व्व, and काष्ठा quarter.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Done formerly, or in a prior existence.
E.
पूर्व्व, and कृत done.

f. (-ङ्गा)
The Narmadā river.
E.
पूर्व्व formerly, (called) गङ्गा the Ganges.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Formerly stated, before-mentioned, aforesaid.
E.
पूर्व्व, and चोदित said.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Born or produced before either in time or place.
2 Eastern, born in the east.
3 Elder.
m. (-जः)
1 An elder brother.
2 The son of the elder wife, even though last born.
m. plu. (-जाः)
1 The deified progenitors of mankind.
2 Ancestors, forefathers in general.
E.
पूर्व्व formerly or first, ज born.

m. (-नः)
A Bauddha teacher; also MAÑJUGHOṢA.
m. plu. (-नाः)
The twenty-four Jinas or Jaina saints of a former æra.
E.
पूर्व्व, and जिन a Jina.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Former.
E.
पूर्व्व, and द्यु aff.

m. (-तिः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
पूर्व्व east, दिश् quarter, and पति regent.

f. (-दिक्)
The eastern region.
E.
पूर्व्व, and दिश a quarter.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Formerly seen.
E.
पूर्व्व, and दृष्ट seen.

m. (-वः)
1 An Asura or demon.
2 A Pitṛ, or progenitor.
E.
पूर्व्व before, देव a god; the first being the elder offspring of KAŚYAPA, the parent of both gods and demons, and the second being the progenitor of gods and men.

f. (-ता)
A primeval deity, a Pitṛ or progenitor of gods as well as men.
E.
पूर्व्व, and देवता a divinity.

m. (-शः)
The eastern country, or eastern part of India.
E.
पूर्व्व eastern, देश country.

m. (-हः)
A former body, a prior existence.
E.
पूर्व्व, and देह body.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A proposition, an assertion; the first part of an argument, to which assent or refutation is necessary.
2 The first half of a lunar month.
E.
पूर्व्व first, पक्ष argument, &c.

m. (-दः)
The first division of legal proceeding, the plaint.
E.
पूर्व्वपक्ष, and पाद quarter.

n. (-दं)
The first member of a compounded word, of a sentence, a verse, &c.
E.
पूर्व्व preceding, and पद a word, &c.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Relating to the first member of a compound term.
E.
पूर्व्वपद, and इकन् aff.

m. (-तः)
The eastern mountain, behind which the sun is supposed to rise.
E.
पूर्व्व eastern, and पर्व्वत a mountain.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Formerly fixed, or done.
E.
पूर्व्व, and प्रवृत्त undertaken.

f. (-नी)
The eleventh lunar asterism; the first Phalgunī, the twelfth Nakṣatra, being termed Uttara or subsequent; this asterism figured by a couch contains two stars, one of which is δ Leonis.
E.
पूर्व्व first, and फल्गुनी the name of the two asterisms.

m. (-वः)
The planet Jupiter.
E.
पूर्व्वफल्गुनी as above, and भव being born.

f. (दा)
The first of the two lunar asterisms, called Bhādrapadā, and twenty-sixth, of the whole, containing two stars.
E.
पूर्व्व first, and भाद्रपदा the asterism so named; it is also read पूर्व्वभद्रपदा.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Polite, complaisant, condescending to speak first.
E.
पूर्व्व, and भाषिन् who speaks.

f. (-क्तिः)
Prior possession.
E.
पूर्व्व, and भुक्ति enjoyment.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Dying first.
E.
पूर्व्व, मृ to die, घिणुन् aff.

m. (-क्षः)
One of the Jinas or Jaina teachers.
E.
पूर्व्व formerly, यक्ष a demigod.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The commencement of a drama, or the prelude to instrumental or vocal performance; a prologue, an overture.
E.
पूर्व्व first, रङ्ग a stage.

m. (-गः)
Affection arising from some cause before the parties meet.
E.
पूर्व्व, and राग passion.

m. (-त्रः)
The first part of the night.
E.
पूर्व्व preceding, रात्रि night, and the final changed to अ.

n. (-पं)
1 Indication of some approaching change.
2 Symptom of occurring disease.
E.
पूर्व्व previous, रूप form.

n. (-णं)
Indication of something about to occur, as sickness, &c.
E.
पूर्व्व, and लक्षण sign.

ind.
As before, as aforesaid, &c.
E.
पूर्व्व, and वति aff.

n. (-दं)
A former plaint or averment.
E.
पूर्व्व former, and वाद speech.

m. (-दी)
One who has made a former plea or complaint.
E.
पूर्व्ववाद, and इनि aff.

m. (-लः)
The eastern mountain, behind which the sun is supposed to rise.
E.
पूर्व्व eastern, शैल a mountain.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Preceding, going before.
E.
पूर्व्व first, सृ to go, aff. ट.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Going eastwards.
E.
पूर्व्व east, and सृ to go, aff. अण्.

f. (-न्ध्या)
Dawn, daybreak.
E.
पूर्व्व prior, and सन्ध्या junction, (of the day.)

n. (-सं)
The first or heaviest fine, or punishment.
E.
पूर्व्व, and साहस infliction.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Done or followed formerly.
E.
पूर्व्व, and आचरित observed.

m. (-द्रिः)
The eastern mountain.
E.
पूर्व्व eastern, and अद्रि mountain: see पूर्व्वशैल.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
First and last, prior and subsequent.
n. (-रं)
Proof, and thing to be proved.
E.
पूर्व्व, and अपर after.

m. (-सः)
Former practice, or experience.
E.
पूर्व्व, and अभ्यास practice.

n. (-र्द्धः)
The first or east half of any thing.
E.
पूर्व्व, and अर्द्ध half.

m. (-रः)
First accession or attack, (of any passion, disease, &c.)
E.
पूर्व्व, and अवतर befalling.

m. (-कः)
A plaintiff, one who has made a complaint before another.
E.
पूर्व्व, and आवेदक who represents.

f. (-ढा)
The first of two constellations, each called Āṣārhā, and the 20th of the lunar asterisms, containing two stars of which one is δ Sagitarii.
E.
पूर्व्व first, आषाढा Āṣārhā.

m. (-ह्नः)
The first part of the day, the forenoon.
E.
पूर्व्व first, and अहन् day.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Belonging or relating to the forenoon.
E.
पूर्व्वाह्र as above, द्यु aff., form irr.

ind.
In the east, easterly, eastward.
E.
पूर्व्व the east, and the form of the 3rd case used as a particle.

ind.
1 A former day, yesterday.
2 The morning, dawn, the first part of the day.
3 A day or portion of a day on which [] religious ceremonies are to be performed.
E.
पूर्व्व former or first, and एद्युस् aff. for द्यु a day.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Said formerly, before-mentioned, aforesaid.
E.
पूर्व्व, and उक्त said.

nf. (-रं-रा)
The north-east.
E.
पूर्व्व east, and उत्तर north.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Aforesaid, aforementioned.
E.
पूर्व्व, and उदित said.
